rows.text: returns 0 when `ecx` is zero; otherwise calls `0035D490()`, picks the table offset from `edx` (1 gives `0x1700`, 2 gives `0x1600`, 3 gives `0x1800`, any other value `0x1500`) and walks the 32 qwords at that offset of the returned pointer, returning the first qword whose dword `+0x98` names a bit (`bt`) that is set in the original `ecx`, or 0 when none of the 32 does
calls `0035D490()` and returns its pointer plus `0x1700` when `ecx` is 1, plus `0x1600` when 2, plus `0x1800` when 3, and plus `0x1500` for any other value

walks the list headed by qword `+0x10F20` of `rcx` (next link qword `+0x9B0`) and returns the first node whose dword `+0x980` equals `r9d`; otherwise allocates `0x9D0` bytes with `00273A30(0, qword +0x10FC0 of qword 0209BE80, 0x9D0)` (returning 0 when that fails), runs `00275550(node, 0x9D0)` twice, then calls `00202C90(node+0x960, r8)` when `r8` is non-null, else ORs 2 into byte `+0x991`, stores `r9d` at `+0x980` and calls `002713E0(node+0x960, r9d)`; stores `dl` at byte `+0x990`, ORs 4 into `+0x991` when the fifth (stack) argument is non-zero and stores the sixth (stack, float) argument at `+0x9A8`; fills qword `+0x10F50` of `rcx` from `0024A5A0(qword 01E0C1E0)` when it is null and copies it to `+0x988`; calls `00271140` and `003F2600(node, ...)` on a stack buffer, stores word 1 at `+0x9C0`, links the node in with `003F2580(old head, node)` into `+0x10F20` and returns the node

calls `003588B0(rcx)`; when the result is null, or its qword `+0xC0` is null, or the dword at that pointer is -1, stores 1 at dword `[rdx]` and 0 at dword `[r8]` and returns; otherwise returns without stores when the word at that pointer is `0xFFFF`, when the word sign-extended times `0x740` plus qword `022C6F28` is zero, or when dword `+0x284` of that record is zero, and else tail-jumps `003E4EA0(record, rdx, r8)`

returns -1 when `rcx` is null, `00263E30(rcx)` returns null, or qword `+0x698` of that result is null; otherwise ORs dwords `+0x64` and `+0x3C` of the `+0x698` object and, when bit 16 is set, returns dword `+0x48` raised to at least 1 (signed), else returns dword `+0x24`, doubled when bit 28 is set
returns 1 when `003588B0(003590D0())` is non-null and `00264E10` of that pointer returns non-zero, else 0

takes `00267E10(r9)`; when it is non-negative (signed) resolves the object with `00358940(002640C0(), value)`, otherwise with `003588B0(003590D0())`, and tail-jumps `003B6F80(object)` when the object is non-null, else returns 0
resolves `003588B0(00267E10(r9))` and, when that is non-null and `00262F50(rdx, object)` returns non-zero, calls `0035AE10(object, 1)`
resolves `003588B0(00267E10(r9))` and tail-jumps `00262F50(rdx, object)` when it is non-null, else returns 0
resolves `003588B0(003590D0())`; when non-null tail-jumps `0034EBC0(rcx, object, r8, r9)`, otherwise calls `00267DB0(r9)` three times, the third as a tail jump

resolves `003588B0(003590D0())` and reads a float with `00267DB0(r9)`, passing it as `0026B620(object, float)` when the object is non-null; then resolves `003588B0(003590D0())` again and calls `0034EBC0(rcx, object, r8, r9)` when non-null, otherwise calls `00267DB0(r9)` three times

reads a float radius with `00267DB0(r9)` and an index with `00267E10(r9)`, resolves `00358940(002640C0(), index)` and `003588B0(003590D0())`; when both are non-null, fills three floats with `00265020(first, &a, &b, &c)` and sets the result to 1 when the radius squared is greater (`comiss`, `cmova`) than the squared distance between floats `+0`, `+4`, `+8` at qword `+0xB8` of the second object and `a`, `b`, `c`, else 0; tail-jumps `0026B4E0(rcx, result)`

reads a float radius with `00267DB0(r9)` and an index with `00267E10(r9)`, resolves `00358940(002640C0(), index)` and `003588B0(003590D0())`; when both are non-null, fills three floats with `00265020(first, &a, &b, &c)` and sets the result to 1 when the radius squared is greater (`comiss`, `cmova`) than the squared two-axis distance of floats `+0` and `+8` at qword `+0xB8` of the second object from `a` and `c` (`b` unused), else 0; tail-jumps `0026B4E0(rcx, result)`

reads four floats with `00267DB0(r9)` (radius, then values 2, 3, 4) and resolves `003588B0(003590D0())`; when non-null, sets the result to 1 when the radius squared is greater (`comiss`, `cmova`) than the squared distance of floats `+0`, `+4`, `+8` at qword `+0xB8` of the object from values 4, 3 and 2 respectively, else (also for a null object) 0; tail-jumps `0026B4E0(rcx, result)`

reads three floats with `00267DB0(r9)` (radius, then values 2 and 3) and resolves `003588B0(003590D0())`; when non-null, sets the result to 1 when the radius squared is greater (`comiss`, `cmova`) than the squared two-axis distance of floats `+0` and `+8` at qword `+0xB8` of the object from values 3 and 2 respectively, else (also for a null object) 0; tail-jumps `0026B4E0(rcx, result)`
calls `002640C0()` and `00267E10(r9)` without keeping their results, then stores the qword `003588B0(003590D0())` at `[r8]`
calls `002547D0(ecx)`, then tail-jumps `00254E70()` when `ecx` was zero and returns otherwise
